requests.title: Competition scope of the next Indy Init build
requests.question: Approve docs/release-gate-repair/competition-scope.proposed.json (sha256 1aae1e1de4cb3af267973076cff3112ec50442fb5f8b71f8f3a820bc8b1525ae) as the competition scope: every obligation of the frozen plan (161 P0 requirements, 613 obligations: 541 executable, 119 record, 47 mixed) plus CAT-CAUSA-INVESTIGATION INV-001..038, with no exclusion?
options: A: approve the proposed scope as is (nothing excluded)

B: approve a narrower scope: name each requirement to exclude; each exclusion is also recorded as the plan's own exclusion {requirement_id, action: exclude} (exclusionPolicy), and the scope file lists it
C: catalog-only competition release: exclude all 161 frozen-plan requirements (613 obligations); the full-plan level then stays REFUSED and is reported as such
requests.recommendation: A, unless the build is staffed and timed to make it achievable; B only with every exclusion named. The agent proposes no exclusion: in Rehearsal 009 every frozen-plan obligation was unimplemented, not inapplicable.
requests.impact: Until this is recorded, r9.fsx acceptance-status reports the competition-scope level SCOPE-NOT-APPROVED and the scope is the whole frozen plan.
